en: Multi-view color postcard showing river and town panoramas. The main upper image depicts a broad bend of a river with bridges, a historic town, hills and forests; the caption reads "Tetschen-Bodenbach" and "Elbepanorama." The lower-left image shows a steep rocky hill with a small structure on top above a town street, captioned "Schäferwand." The lower-right image shows another river view with a paddle steamer, bridges, and riverside buildings, captioned "Elbepartie." The style is that of an early 20th‑century chromolithographic postcard.
